summary_ja: 承認の取消し事由を定める。
summary_en: Allows the Commissioner to revoke the Article 217 approval where continued use of the model is inappropriate following the cases in Article 222.
paragraphs: Where the cases set out in the items of paragraph (1) of the preceding Article apply, or where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach has failed to comply with the submission obligation prescribed in paragraph (2) of that Article, and the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency judges it inappropriate to allow the continued use of the exposure fluctuation estimation model, the Commissioner may revoke the approval under Article 217, paragraph (1) for that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach.
